video.title: The Laziest One-Person Business You Can Start

summary: Chris Koerner demos Higgsfield's 'Supercomputer', an agentic creative tool (powered by Hermes) connected to Claude via MCP. It scans TikTok, YouTube Shorts and Instagram for trends, generates brand assets, a website mockup, PDFs and faceless TikToks, and can clone a viral video's format. He suggests using it to run an AI implementation agency (audit foot-in-door then $1-5K/month), plus real-estate listing marketing, finding under-monetised creators, and AI influencers. The video is sponsored by Higgsfield and Koerner promotes his own Playmakers community; income claims are hypothetical.

tactics.name: Trend-picker content research
steps: Connect Higgsfield to Claude via custom connector (MCP)
Run the Trend Picker skill for your niche
Review top viral videos, hooks, hashtags and creators
Make your own version of the best-performing formats

tactics.name: Clone a viral video format
steps: Find a viral TikTok in your niche
Ask for a version in your own style, changing little because it's proven

tactics.name: Free audit foot-in-door for AI agency
steps: Offer a low-cost or free AI audit
Use generated flyer, PDF, website and TikToks as marketing

tactics.name: Give the work away first
steps: Create sample work (listing package or creator content plan)

warnings.warning: If the AI influencer isn't working after a month, pivot rather than persist.

lessons.lesson: Distribution, not building, is the bottleneck, so tools that automate content and trend-finding address the hard part.

quote.text: distribution, AKA sales and marketing has never been harder
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

lessons.lesson: Copy a proven viral format and make it your own rather than starting from zero.
Giving free sample work demonstrates effort and can convert to recurring paid work.
Reading an AI tool's reasoning shows how it works and suggests better prompts.
A lightweight audit as an entry offer leading to retainers is a common agency structure.
Set a time-boxed test (one month) before pivoting on a new content experiment.

evidence_quality.rationale: Sponsored product demo with hypothetical income maths and no real customer results; the demo itself is first-hand but shows only outputs.
evidence_quality.promotional_conflict: Higgsfield sponsors the podcast, Koerner offers an affiliate-style discount, and he promotes his Playmakers.ai community.
